newsitem.title: LIBERIA: Vote counting starts in Liberia as polls close.
newsitem.headline: Vote counting starts in Liberia as polls close.

text.p: Polls closed in Liberia's first elections for 12 years on Saturday and counting of ballots started, poll officials said.

The elections, wrapping up a regional peace programme to end seven years of civil war, were marked by heavy turnout but most voters were able to cast their ballots long before the 4.00 P.M. (1600 GMT) close of polls, they said.
More than 500 international observers monitored the voting. No incidents were immediately reported.
Voters were chosing a president from 12 candidates and a parliament through proportional representation.
First returns are due on Sunday evening but final results are not expected until Wednesday, officials said.
